question: Under what conditions should multi-agent become the default for Codex Factory in large-project context?
currentState: Multi-agent is NOT default. It must be earned through evidence.
whatCannotDecide: Sunk cost of prior multi-agent development

decisionCriteria.threshold: At least ONE benchmark on a 50+ feature, 5+ independent module project showing multi-agent beats both Vanilla and v0.4 Factory Lite
Multi-agent produces fewer integration defects, better architecture preservation, and higher test coverage than Vanilla
Agent coordination overhead is less than 30% of total project time; net time benefit over Vanilla is positive or neutral with quality gain
Multi-agent does not make small/medium projects worse (it just may not be the default for those)
If benchmark shows multi-agent WORSE than Vanilla on 3+ independent large projects, it should be deprecated for large projects too

falsificationProtocol.minimumWorseThreshold: 3 independent large-project benchmarks where v0.5 underperforms Vanilla
falsificationProtocol.rule: If FACTORY-AGENT-8 shows v0.5 Agent Company mode is WORSE than Vanilla on a large project benchmark, multi-agent must NOT become default
falsificationProtocol.whatHappensIfFalsified: Multi-agent is deprecated as a large-project strategy. Codex Factory remains v0.4 Process Integrity Layer only. Research into alternative large-project strategies continues.
